reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
생각보다 반응이 너무 좋아요😂
보자마자 물고 당기고 난리ㅋㅋㅋ
끈 부분도 잡기 좋고 공처럼 생긴 부분도 있어서 혼자서도 잘 가지고 놀아요!
터그놀이 해주면 더 신나해서 한참 놀아줬네요💙
요즘 최애 장난감 됐어요ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: The response is so much better than I expected😂 As soon as she saw it, she was biting and pulling at it like crazy ㅋㅋㅋ The rope part is easy to grab and there's also a ball-like section, so she plays with it well on her own! When we play tug-of-war she gets even more excited, so we played for quite a while💙 It's become her favorite toy these days ㅎㅎ

reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content:
아이가 보자마자 가지고 논다며 신났어요!
던지고 뺏고 으르렁 거리고 신나서🫣
저녁 먹고 한시간을 신나게 놀았답니다❤️
reviews.content_en: My pup was so excited the moment he saw it and wanted to play with it right away! Throwing it, taking it back, growling and having a blast🫣 After dinner he played happily for a whole hour❤️
